name: MCB 1200
title: Virus Hunters
description: Introduction to the biology of bacterial viruses (phages). Isolation from the environment and characterization of a novel phage for sequencing in MCB 1201. Data from this classroom-based research experience will be shared in a nationwide program fostering discovery-based undergraduate research. May be taken before or after MCB 1201 for students choosing both classes. CA 3-LAB.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
